name: Deus Ex Submarine
source:
You are Captain Clarence Giles of the HMS Elizabeth, a Valiant-class Nuclear Submarine. Ten minutes ago a critical hull breach occurred. This seemed to be caused by an unknown object. 

Will you be able to save the surviving crew? Or will you fight for your survival over their dead bodies? Will you find out why in heaven's name there is a pair of sunglasses on your desk in a submarine? And will you be able to resist the lure of the minty chocolate wafers? 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151028052147/http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-29/?action=preview&uid=20442]Ludum Dare[/url]]

Created for [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/2014/04/23/welcome-to-ludum-dare-29er/]Ludum Dare 29[/url].
translation:
你是“伊丽莎白号”核潜艇的舰长克拉伦斯·贾尔斯。这艘潜艇属于勇士级。十分钟前，舰体发生严重破损，似乎是由某种未知物体造成的。

你能拯救幸存的船员吗？还是会踩着他们的尸体为生存而战？你能查明潜艇里为什么会在你的桌上摆着一副太阳镜吗？你能抵挡薄荷巧克力威化饼的诱惑吗？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151028052147/http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-29/?action=preview&uid=20442]Ludum Dare[/url]]

为[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/2014/04/23/welcome-to-ludum-dare-29er/]Ludum Dare 29[/url]制作。
